channel.title: GiveOwl – 12 Days of Christmas giveaways 2026
channel.description: "12 Days" giveaways are promotions where a sponsor gives away a different prize on each of twelve (or so) days, usually in late November or December. These are the ones from US sponsors we have checked against the official rules. Most treat each day as a separate drawing, so you may need to enter again every day.

item.title: The Office Depot 12 Days of Giveaways – Office Depot, LLC
item.description: Prize: 12 office-product prize bundles (ARV $399.99–$1,269.97 each), one winner per bundle. Deadline: November 25, 2026. A new giveaway is announced each day Nov 9–20; enter each one once on officedepot.com/l/marketing/giveaways (email, phone, mailing address). All close Nov 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. 50 US + DC, age of majority
